_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

Credit card FAQ: lists the Aspire, Royale, Euphoria, Imperium and Winnings variants with their networks

open_questions: Value of one Delight Point in rupees: NOT STATED by IDBI in the card page, MITC or FAQ read. Point value, effective return and every rupee value of a bonus or milestone stay null. Question for IDBI: what is one Delight Point worth in rupees for this card, and on what redemption (the MITC mentions only a Rs 20 fee for cash-back redemption between 1,000 and 4,000 points)?
Delight Points expiry: the MITC says points expire after 3 years (campaign points after 1 year). Taken as 36 months.
Late fee and interest come from the MITC fee schedule "effective from April 13, 2023" inside a file created 23 Oct 2026; the card page values match it.
Cash advance fee is 2.5% of the amount or Rs 500, whichever is higher; the page wording says "transaction fee" and is read as the transaction amount (MITC section 1b says "transaction amount").

The milestone benefits on the page are bonus points on net annual spend; the page does not say whether the year is the card year or a calendar year, so the period is a guess flagged here: card_anniversary_year is used.
The page says Delight Points accrue on all transactions except the MCC list in MITC section 12; the exemptions on the page are linked ("refer exempted categories here"), and the MITC list was used.

Joining fee conflict: the card page says joining fee Rs 499 and annual Rs 499; the MITC schedule says joining nil, annual Rs 499 (waived on Rs 75,000 spend) and closure charge Rs 999 within one year. The MITC (newer file) is used: joining 0.
Fuel waiver: the page text names the "Aspire Platinum Card" and says up to Rs 300 a month (copied wording); the MITC schedule says Rs 400 a month for Imperium. The MITC value is used.
Assignment note said "Visa" from the FAQ: the FAQ lists "Imperium Platinum Card (Visa)" and the page says "issued on the VISA platform".
